newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long-liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker on Friday, as private investors liquidated their longs, pressured by the yen's firmer tone, and ahead of the spot expiry on Monday, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.9 yen per kilogram lower. Most-active benchmark April was 0.8 yen weaker at 142.5 yen.

Prices opened lower, with market sentiment carried over weaker tone from the previous day. "Open interest of rubber futures has fallen, reflecting a lack of interest," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
